archetype: Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury) blended with Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) - Deep Forest and Money Green

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter leading-none font-serif font-medium text-text_primary
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-serif font-medium text-text_primary
scale.h3: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-sans tracking-tight font-semibold text-text_primary

typography.instructions: Use Cormorant Garamond for all massive hero numbers (e.g., total portfolio value, MRR) and main H1/H2 headings. Use Chivo for all UI elements, buttons, and dense data labels. Never use Inter or Roboto.

layout_spacing.grid_system: Bento Grid (Control Room Grid for Dashboard)
layout_spacing.container_padding: Generous padding: p-6 or p-8 for cards
layout_spacing.general: Optical alignment over geometrical. Asymmetric hero section. Mobile-first design. Generous spacing.

surfaces_micro_themes.cards: Flat solid background (#071B13), subtle 1px border (#173627). No generic box-shadows. On hover, translate-y-[-2px] and border lightens to #00D084/50.
surfaces_micro_themes.glassmorphism: Only for sticky nav: bg-[#04120C]/70 with backdrop-blur-xl and border-b border-[#173627]
surfaces_micro_themes.buttons: Primary CTA: bg-[#00D084] text-[#04120C] font-semibold. Hover: bg-[#10B981] text-[#04120C]. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#173627] text-[#F4F0E6]. Hover: border-[#00D084] text-[#00D084].

components.forms: Use highly customized Shadcn inputs with bg-[#071B13], border-[#173627], focus:border-[#00D084] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00D084]
components.charts: Recharts with dark mode support. Tooltips must use bg-[#0C2419] with border-[#173627]. Use bright green (#00D084) for line/area charts with a gradient fill to transparent.
components.icons: lucide-react, 1.5px stroke width. Use sparse, meaningful icons.
components.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='login-button', data-testid='add-income-stream-cta').

motion_interactions.hover_states: Micro-animations on hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) for cards, color shifts for borders.
motion_interactions.entrance: Staggered fade-up for dashboard widgets and feed items using Framer Motion (initial={{opacity:0, y:20}} animate={{opacity:1, y:0}}).

images.description: Abstract dark emerald green and cream 3D rendering of smooth organic topographical lines. Use as a background overlay in the hero section with low opacity (bg-black/40).
Minimalist premium 3D icon of a modern AI sphere. Use for the AI Coach Chat avatar.
Dark elegant architectural interior. Use for the split-screen login/register page background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a deep forest green dark theme based on the color palette. Never use default slate/gray/zinc.
Use Cormorant Garamond for all large metrics/numbers and H1/H2. Use Chivo for UI elements.
Use Recharts for the Income streams breakdown (donut chart), per-stream trend charts, and DCA compound growth line chart.
Dashboard must feel like a premium financial operating system: dense, precise, and dark.
Incorporate the generated images for the hero, AI coach avatar, and auth background.
Ensure every single interactive element has a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
Use strict Tailwind classes for colors mapping to the palette provided.
Add a subtle noise/grain texture overlay to the overall background to increase the premium feel.
